pages.text: An HF radio you carry: low-power $(thing)SSB and CW$() on 10 and 20 m, with its own whip. Sneak and right click to wear it on your chest (or in a Curios back slot). Right click it in hand, or press $(thing)J$() (Open Worn Manpack), for the panel: power, mode, band, the tuning knob, AF and mic gain, PTT and the battery.$(br2)The whip is fine by ground wave but poor for skip, and weaker indoors.

pages.title: Handset and battery
pages.text: Click the handset on the panel to take it in hand: hold right click to talk, sneak and right click to hang it up.$(br2)The battery runs about four days listening (2 FE/t, 13 transmitting). To swap it, hold a $(item)small battery$() in your other hand and sneak-use: the two trade charge.
